player_prompt.intro:
O tlile go tlhola Tower of Hanoi le {num_disks} disks.
O na le kwelo ya go tsamaya le disks tse ko tower A go ya tower C.
Go tsamaya le disk, ngwala tower e o tswang kwa goe le tower e o yang kwa goe (e.g., '[A C]').
Gakololwe hwe, o ka tsamaya le disk e e kwa godimo kwa tower, mme disk e e kgolokgolo ha e ke e tsamaywe kwa disk e e nnego.
Ka ngwaga le ngwaga, naya kgelo e le nngwe.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ga o arabisitswe ka tsela e e nnelang '[source] [target]'.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: O ne wa tlhalosa gore sedirisiwa se o batlang go tswa mo go sone ga se a tshwanela.
invalid_move.empty_tower: O ne wa leka go sutisa disk mo toreng e e se nang sepe.
invalid_move.same_tower: O ne wa leka go isa disiki kwa toreng e le nngwe.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: O ne wa leka go baya disiki e kgolwane mo godimo ga e nnye.

game_action.moved: O fudusitse disiki {disk} go tswa mo {source} go ya kwa {target}.

outcome.win: Ke a lo akgola! Lo ne lwa rarabolola thamalakane ya Tora ya Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: O beile sentle {pct}% ya disiki mo Toreng C.
